eGFR_threshold.fact: Minimum baseline eGFR threshold for Phase-3 CardioVex inclusion is 45 mL/min/1.73m2 (CKD-EPI equation; adult heart failure 40-80 years; <45 strictly excluded).

sae_reporting_timeline.fact: Serious Adverse Events (SAEs) must be reported to the central Pharmacovigilance Safety Desk within 24 hours of initial site awareness via the electronic eCRF.

storage_temperature.fact: Reconstituted CardioVex vials must be stored strictly between 2°C and 8°C (2 to 8 degrees Celsius) in a calibrated refrigerator with continuous logging; do not freeze.

investigational_status_and_pricing.fact: CardioVex (CVX-409) is an investigational drug in Phase III clinical development, supplied solely for clinical trial use in numbered study vials. It is not approved or sold in commercial retail pharmacies, so no commercial wholesale or retail price exists.

population_and_pediatric_scope.fact: The protocol exclusively investigates adult patients aged 40-80 with chronic heart failure (NYHA II-III). Paediatric conditions (e.g. ear infections) and non-trial antibiotics like amoxicillin are completely absent from the trial.
